sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak optional reference is automatically set to nil when the referenced object has no strong owners.
sketches.resonance: What is not held strongly is allowed to vanish, leaving only a checked absence.

sketches.mechanism: Range-constrained subtypes perform constraint checks on assignment and raise Constraint_Error for values outside the declared bounds.
sketches.resonance: A vow with only one permitted shape breaks the moment it tries to become more.

sketches.mechanism: In Lua tables, assigning nil to a key deletes that key because nil cannot be stored as a present value.
sketches.resonance: To put nothing in a place is to remove the place from memory.

local altar = {}
altar[1] = true
altar[1] = nil
